concepts.def: Checking which of two items is bigger.
One full sweep through the list.
The middle index of the current search range.
Match located — algorithm returns its index.
Target absent — search ends without a match.

walkthroughs.body_html: Pass 1: (4,2)→(2,4) gives [2,4,3]; (4,3)→(3,4) gives [2,3,4]. Pass 2: no swaps. Done in 2 swaps over 2 passes.
Index 0: 3? no. Index 1: 7? no. Index 2: 9? yes, return 2. Three comparisons.
